name: invigorated-slash-plus-two-power-after-champion-leveled-up
notes: Invigorated Slash (W1g0hNzXAC, NORM WARRIOR/SWORD attack, reserve 2, power 2): "As long as your champion has leveled up this turn, Invigorated Slash gets +2 POWER." The champion is patched to Mordred, Flawless Blade (level 2, lineage without Burnished Avenger so its inherited discount is not involved) and performs a REAL level-up into Mordred, Fated Luminary (3 memory cards) in the turn-3 materialize phase; Invigorated Slash is then played (2 reserve) and hits player 2's champion for 2 + 2 = 4.

rulesClauses: As long as your champion has leveled up this turn, Invigorated Slash gets +2 POWER.
